description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, R&D - IntelliScript based in the United States. 

 Position Overview 

 The Software Engineer, R&D will play a key role in driving early-stage innovation and developing next-generation software products and capabilities. This position focuses on transforming emerging ideas and complex business challenges into functional prototypes, minimum viable products (MVPs), and scalable solutions. Working within a collaborative, cross-functional research and development team, the successful candidate will rapidly experiment with new technologies, validate concepts, and refine solutions based on user feedback and data-driven insights. The role combines hands-on software engineering with creative problem-solving, particularly across cloud-native development and AI-driven technologies. This is an opportunity to shape innovative SaaS products, influence technical direction, and help identify new opportunities for long-term business growth.



Accountabilities:
 
 Drive research and development initiatives by designing, building, testing, and refining early-stage software solutions that address emerging business needs. Work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to validate ideas, accelerate product experimentation, and transform successful concepts into solutions with long-term potential.


 
 Design, develop, and continuously improve MVPs, prototypes, and early-stage software solutions to explore new product opportunities.



 
 Rapidly test concepts through lightweight implementations and gather feedback from real users to validate their potential.



 
 Translate ambiguous business challenges and emerging requirements into practical technical solutions.



 
 Refine product concepts through experimentation, data analysis, and user insights to identify the most valuable opportunities.



 
 Build and deploy solutions primarily within AWS, leveraging cloud-native services to support rapid development and iteration.



 
 Experiment with AI-driven technologies both to accelerate software development and to introduce innovative product capabilities.



 
 Collaborate with small, cross-functional teams to explore, develop, and validate new ideas and technical approaches.



 
 Partner with stakeholders across business units to gather feedback, challenge assumptions, and prioritize high-value problems.



 
 Balance development speed with appropriate engineering standards, ensuring solutions are reliable and maintainable.



 
 Contribute to architectural and technical decisions that enable rapid experimentation while supporting future scalability.



 
 Deploy prototypes and early-stage applications to facilitate real-world testing and continuous learning.



 
 Assess technical tradeoffs, manage development risks, and adapt approaches as project priorities evolve.



 
 Collaborate with downstream engineering teams to transition successful experiments into production-ready, scalable solutions.




 Requirements: 

 The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with a strong technical foundation, a curious mindset, and the ability to thrive in an experimental environment. They combine hands-on development expertise with analytical thinking, adaptability, and a willingness to explore emerging technologies while turning ideas into practical results.


 
 At least 4 years of relevant professional software engineering experience.



 
 Strong hands-on experience with C# (.NET 8), React, and SQL.



 
 Experience developing and deploying cloud-based applications, preferably using AWS.



 
 Understanding of Agile development methodologies, including Scrum.



 
 Experience across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and design through development, testing, and deployment.



 
 Strong technical design, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities.



 
 Ability to analyze business and functional requirements and translate them into effective technical implementations.



 
 Solid understanding of software engineering principles and the ability to apply appropriate development standards.



 
 Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams.



 
 Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to continuously learn, experiment, and develop new technical skills.



 
 Ability to navigate ambiguity, break down complex challenges, and identify practical solutions.



 
 Action-oriented mindset with a focus on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and continuous improvement.



 
 Comfort with experimentation and failure, including the ability to discontinue concepts that do not demonstrate sufficient business value.



 
 Ability to communicate evolving ideas clearly, influence stakeholders, and align teams around shared objectives.



 
 Long-term results orientation and willingness to collaborate with engineering teams to scale successful innovations.




 Nice to Have:


 
 Experience working in environments subject to HIPAA and/or PCI regulations, with an understanding of balancing compliance requirements and rapid innovation.



 
 Previous experience in software-as-a-service (SaaS) environments.



 
 Knowledge of domain-driven design principles.



 
 Experience designing and developing modern software architectures, including microservices and event-driven systems.



 
 AWS certifications or extensive hands-on experience with AWS cloud-native services.



 
 Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) or similar software quality practices.



 
 Experience using Generative AI or other emerging technologies for product development and rapid prototyping.



 
 Background in healthcare technology, healthcare data, or interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7.



 
 Knowledge of clinical informatics, medical claims, or electronic health record data, including ICD-10 and related data structures.




 Benefits: 


 
 Annual salary ranging from $80,376 to $203,046, depending on location, experience, qualifications, and skills.



 
 For candidates in Alaska, California, Connecticut, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York City, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Washington, and Washington, D.C.:



 
 $92,432–$148,033 for candidates with less than 5 years of overall experience.



 
 $123,048–$203,046 for candidates with more than 5 years of overall experience.





 
 For candidates in all other states:



 
 $80,376–$128,724 for candidates with less than 5 years of overall experience.



 
 $106,998–$176,562 for candidates with more than 5 years of overall experience.





 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees, dependents, and domestic partners.



 
 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching and profit-sharing contributions.



 
 Discretionary bonus program recognizing employee contributions.



 
 Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for eligible healthcare, dependent care, and transportation expenses.



 
 Paid time off accruing from the first day of employment, with 15 days annually for full-time employees.



 
 At least 10 paid holidays per year.



 
 Family-building benefits, including adoption and fertility assistance.



 
 Up to 11 weeks of paid parental leave for eligible employees.



 
 Employer-paid life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) coverage.



 
 Fully paid short-term and long-term disability insurance.



 
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential personal and professional support.



 
 Access to professional development, technical training, and mentoring opportunities.



 
 Employee-led resource groups and opportunities to contribute to professional communities.



 
 Fully remote working arrangement within the United States.
